items.title: Should Boston Scientific (BSX) Investors Worry About These FDA Class II Recalls?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (NYSE:BSX) reported multiple FDA-listed Class II recalls of its Neuromodulation system and Direxion Torqueable Microcatheters in 2026. The Neuromodulation system recall followed enforcement reports citing firmware failures that could affect device performance in patients. Direxion Torqueable Microcatheter recalls were linked to manufacturing concerns involving device coatings and sleeve alignment across several product models.
